0022600198.text: The Timberwolves (7-3, on a three-game win streak) host the Utah Jazz (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak), with Minnesota third in the Northwest and one game back in the division and sixth in the West. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery; averaging 33.3 points) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Joan Beringer is day-to-day with a fracture and a game-time decision. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Minnesota won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
